market_question: Will Crude Oil (CL) hit (LOW) $40 by end of June?
reasoning: WTI crude is ~$70 now; a drop to $40 requires a ~43% decline. Over 14 months, that level has been reached in severe recessions or oversupply shocks (e.g., 2008, 2014-16, 2020). Given current recession risks (trade wars, China slowdown) and potential OPEC+ policy shifts, I estimate a ~6% chance, far above the 1.1% market-implied probability. Comparable options markets would price this probability much higher.
evidence_points: Settlement price below $40 occurred multiple times historically: e.g., 2008-09, 2015-16, 2020.
Current WTI price ~$70 implies a 43% decline needed; volatility around 30% gives a hit probability ~8% under risk-neutral measure.
Geopolitical and macroeconomic risks (tariffs, recession, OPEC+ unwinding) could trigger sharp oil selloffs.
